basis.quote:
it is hereby ordered that T. 41 N., R. 6 E. , Boise meridian, be transferred
from the St. Joe to the Clearwater National Forest, in the State of Idaho . This
transfer is to be effective from July 1 , 1931 .
basis.role: own terms: one-time transfer, effective 1931-07-01 (performed act)

proposed_intervals.scope: whole order (transfer of T. 41 N., R. 6 E., Boise meridian, from St. Joe to Clearwater National Forest)
proposed_intervals.end_basis: The order is a one-time self-executing transfer made 'effective from July 1 , 1931'; the command was performed on that date. The transferred status of the land is a surviving consequence, not the order in force.

searches_run: cruden.py number EO:5615: 4 hits (/tmp/claude-0/herschel-H6-work/H6-w02/cruden-EO_5615.json) - hits are the order's own copies and EO_842 (wikisource note 'Amended by Executive Order 5615'), no later order acting on it
material_gaps: OFR 1974 text is OCR (Google) not human-verified; page images not inspected.
No held source shows the transfer was later reversed or what the land's present forest assignment is; that does not affect the spent command.
rationale: EO 5615 (Hoover, 1931-05-01, register/APP/OFR agree) only transfers one township between national forests, effective July 1, 1931. A self-executing one-time act is exhausted by performance on its effective date (owner ruling 2026-10-28: separate the exhausted command from its surviving consequence). EO 842 note shows 5615 as an amendment to an earlier order, an earlier event not an ending. So not in effect as a command on 2026-10-14. Performance is inferred from the order's self-executing text; no separate held record of the transfer.
